reviews.title: Premium AIO with beautiful LCD and great cooling performance
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1jB7svEJyL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61lLuUY5guL._SY256.jpg The Thermalright FW 360 White ARGB is hands down one of the best AIO coolers I’ve used. It keeps my Ryzen 7 7800X3D running cool even under heavy loads, and the 360mm radiator with ARGB fans not only performs great but looks amazing in a white-themed build.
The standout feature is definitely the 2.4" IPS LCD screen—crisp, colorful, and fully customizable. The magnetic mount makes it super easy to adjust or remove. Whether you display temps, system stats, or custom GIFs, it adds a unique and premium touch to your setup.
Installation was straightforward, with full compatibility for both AMD AM4/AM5 and Intel LGA1700 sockets. If you want excellent cooling, a clean aesthetic, and that extra wow factor with an LCD screen, this AIO is a fantastic choice.
reviews.author: Eyleen Hauls

reviews.title: Thermalright the king of price to performance.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1WNJau+V9L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51vN4rBFE9L._SY256.jpg I purchased this AIO for a new white build theme, and I absolutely adore it. The screen is just the right size, and the colors are great. The cooling performance is comparable to many other competitors, but it’s at a fraction of the cost. It’s also quiet and extremely easy to install.
My only complaint is that the control software is a bit clunky. However, after some tinkering, I found a lot of options that allow you to display temperatures, time, date, and various preset themes.
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.title: Awesome Budget Cooler
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C18zIOUiZHL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61-h0Cbm80L._SY256.jpg I looked at some of the other AIO coolers like the Corsair and NZXT but couldn’t justify spending $250 for a cooler. I’m not overclocking my PC or anything so I figured this would be a good budget option. So far, the temperatures seem to be nice and cool around 30° at idle. I love the LCD and how customizable it is. You can add custom videos or GIFs which is a cool option, as well as change the color and font of the info. 
Overall I’m really happy with this cooler, it looks great and performs well. And the best part is that it’s way cheaper than some of the other AIO coolers out there.
reviews.author: leol

reviews.title: Great Value!
reviews.comment: Works great and keeps my cpu cool. I have the Ryzen 7 7800x3d and this does great. It was super easy to install and has pretty backgrounds! You can even use your own pics but I haven’t tried yet. My only complaint is that it doesn’t save the background sometimes and just won’t show the temps but if you reopen the application it works great. The noise level is about what you’d expect from this price point and it relatively quiet. I have my pc on my desk and I don’t really notice it.
reviews.author: Chey Zona

reviews.title: Works really good!
reviews.comment: Fits perfect. RGB is super nice! Definitely keep my pc COLD if turned up but does more than enough for a 9800x3d on silent mode. Very quiet unless ramped up. Even then not too loud. Compatible with most boards and builds.
reviews.author: Josh Fisher
